will be the only printed edition.
Net income increased $1.4 billion (22.9 percent) compared with second quarter 2024, driven primarily by higher net interest income.
The pretax return on assets ratio at community banks increased 15 basis points from the prior quarter
The rise in the DIF was primarily driven by assessment income of $3.6 billion.
These gains were partially offset by operating expenses of $0.6 billion.
One institution failed during the second quarter.
The increase in provision expense was largely attributable to the acquisition of one large bank
In the second quarter, the Deposit Insurance Fund balance increased $4.4 billion to $145.3 billion.
the FDIC is no longer operating under a Restoration Plan.
During the quarter, the cost of funds decreased 1 basis point while the yield on earning assets remained unchanged
is calculated as the average from first quarter 2015 through fourth quarter 2019.
Net operating revenue (net interest income plus noninterest income) of $266.3 billion increased $3.8 billion (1.4 percent) quarter over quarter
Noninterest income increased $861.6 million (1 percent) from the previous quarter, predominantly due to higher trading revenue.
The efficiency ratio (noninterest expense as a share of net operating revenue) declined from 56.2 percent in first quarter 2025 to 55.6 percent in second quarter 2025.
Quarterly provision expense totaled $30 billion in the second quarter
The reserve coverage ratio (the ratio of the allowance for credit losses to noncurrent loans) was 179.4 percent in second quarter 2025
securities totaled $395.3 billion in the second quarter
The banking industry reported total assets of $25 trillion in the second quarter
Total loan and lease balances of $13.1 trillion increased $263.7 billion (2.1 percent) from the prior quarter.
Domestic deposits increased $101.5 billion (0.6 percent) from first quarter 2025, rising for a fourth consecutive quarter.
The leverage capital ratio decreased 1 basis point from first quarter 2025 to 9.37 percent.
The number of problem banks represented 1.3 percent of total banks in the second quarter
37 institutions merged or consolidated during the quarter.
Through June 30, ratios annualized where appropriate.
Asset growth rates are for 12 months ending June 30.

notes: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile, Second Quarter 2025 (49 pages as served, tagged, Adobe InDesign; the file now served was re-issued on September 10, 2025, after the August 26, 2025 release, see holdout3/SELECTION.md), cut to pages 1-15 with pypdf: page 1 cover, page 2 masthead (publisher statement and staff), page 3 summary ('QUARTERLY BANKING PROFILE: SECOND QUARTER 2025' with three side-headed paragraphs), page 4 'PAGE INTENTIONALLY LEFT BLANK', pages 5-11 (printed 1-7) 'INSURED INSTITUTION PERFORMANCE' with a list of six highlights, side-headed sections and Charts 1-8, page 12 Table I-A, page 13 Table II-A, pages 14-15 Table III-A (page 15 ends Table III-A; Table IV-A starts page 16, which is not in the file). Not checked because they may be images or are graphics: the cover artwork and its title type, the seal, the header band artwork, the charts and their labels and source lines. Headings: the first line of the page-3 title (with its colon; the second line is 'SECOND QUARTER 2025'), the page-3 side headings, the page-5 title and the 14 bold capital side headings of pages 5-11, each as one string although most are printed on two to four lines in the narrow left column. The six blue highlight lines under the page-5 title are a list of findings, not headings; four of them repeat side-heading texts (in title case), and the one-to-one heading match counts each heading line once. The side heading 'NONINTEREST EXPENSE INCREASED MODESTLY FROM THE PRIOR QUARTER AND THE YEAR-AGO QUARTER' is listed up to 'PRIOR QUARTER' to avoid the hyphen, whose code point cannot be seen. Chart titles ('Chart 1', 'Quarterly Net Income', ...) and table titles are captions, not headings. Tables: Table I-A is complete. Table II-A is PARTIAL: only its INCOME DATA block (a second header row inside the table: 'INCOME DATA', 'First Half 2025', ...). Table III-A is printed on two pages with the same title; each page is a separate expected table, PARTIAL: both header rows and the first 12 body rows. Header cells printed on two or three lines are written joined with spaces ('All Insured Institutions', 'Less Than $100 Million', '%Change 24Q2-25Q2'); 'Inter-/national Banks' is written as the word 'International Banks'; the row-spanning headers ('SECOND QUARTER (The way it is...)', 'All Insured Institutions') are written in the top header row and the group headers ('Asset Concentration Groups*', 'Asset Size Distribution', 'Geographic Regions*') in the first column they span. The ellipsis is written '...' (NFKC turns U+2026 into '...'). Asterisk note marks are kept ('2025**', 'Provision for credit losses***'); normalization deletes '*', so '2025**' and '2024**' compare as '2025' and '2024'. Dollar signs are written where printed (first row of a block only). Negative values are written with ASCII hyphen-minus (assumed; the code point cannot be seen), as is the hyphen in '24Q2-25Q2' and 'Net charge-offs'. Repeated row labels ('Commercial banks', 'Savings institutions') are kept as printed, without their indentation. Arithmetic checked while typing: Table I-A commercial banks + savings institutions = institutions reporting in every column; Table II-A total interest income - total interest expense = net interest income (exact), net interest income - provision + noninterest income - noninterest expense + securities gains - taxes + extraordinary gains = total net income (within 1), bank net income - cash dividends = retained earnings (exact), and every %Change cell = the change of its two columns (within 0.1); Table III-A commercial banks + savings institutions = the total row and the groups (asset concentration groups; asset size groups; regions) sum to All Insured Institutions in every block (exact for counts, within 0.3 in the billions rows; the bank net income rows, in millions, are off by 1 in 8 of their sums, which is the publication's own rounding: the cells involved were re-read at 320 dpi and are as printed). must_contain: 29 phrases, each printed once, none crossing a column, page or block break; 6 are footnotes or table notes; no phrase contains a hyphen ('FDIC-insured', 'pre-pandemic', 'year-ago'), an em or en dash ('banks—which', '1–4 family'), an apostrophe ('industry’s') or a quotation mark. Sentences of the page-3 summary that page 5 repeats word for word are not used. ordered: 8 anchors on pages 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11 and 12 (the last a Table I-A note). Noise: the running header band prints 'Quarterly Banking Profile' and '2025 QUARTER 2' on every page after the cover except the blank page 4 (13 times); '2025 QUARTER 2' also appears once on the cover, so max is 1; 'Quarterly Banking Profile' also occurs in the body text and is not counted; page numbers are too short. Absent: the narrative is ragged-right without line-end hyphenation; the only one-word hyphenation is the Table III-A header 'Inter-/national' (page 14), listed in its split form. BLIND PROTOCOL: chosen and answered before any converter or text extractor was run on the file; every check was typed from the rendered pages (pdftoppm at 100-240 dpi, read as images), and the PDF text layer was never read. Consequences: (1) text that may be an image (logos, mastheads, cover art, chart labels) is not checked; (2) invisible text-layer content cannot be known, so noise lists only VISIBLE repeated page furniture; (3) where the exact code point of a glyph cannot be seen (curly vs straight quotes, dash and minus variants), must_contain phrases and ordered anchors avoid it; headings, table cells and absent entries that cannot avoid it are noted per file.
